liquidity-gold.deck: Liquidity Gold sells a browser-based trading desk. We read every page it publishes and checked the claims one at a time.
liquidity-gold.depositMethods: Bank cards, bank transfer, PayPal, Skrill
liquidity-gold.support: Around-the-clock claim; one bullet reads "7 customer support"
intro: Liquidity Gold arrives with the familiar pitch: AI analysis, automatic entries, a US$300 start and a practice account. The pitch is polished. The fine print is where the questions begin, and that is what this review measures.

In practice it works like this: you register free, fund US$300, choose automatic or manual mode, and let the models propose entries across 9 assets while the practice account lets you learn without risk.
Every review on this desk uses the same five criteria, so platforms are comparable. Liquidity Gold was scored on its published material alone - including the parts its own marketing skipped.
whatItClaims: Signals generated without manual chart reading.
A US$300 minimum deposit to start.
Free registration, with account activation by confirmation link.
Risk settings adjustable before the first live trade.
A partner broker holding funds and executing orders.
whatWeChecked: The deposit terms: minimum amount, payment methods and where the money sits.
The demo claim: practice account confirmed in the signup flow.
The payout promise: within-a-day wording without processing detail.
The broker relationship: which partner desk executes orders.
The asset list: how many pairs are actually offered.
The registration flow: what personal details the form collects.

steps.title: Register
steps.text: Register with your name, email and phone number, and confirm via the email you are sent.

steps.title: Fund
steps.text: Make the US$300 first deposit using any of the listed payment methods.

steps.title: Configure
steps.text: Set the risk parameters, decide between automatic and manual, and practise on the demo account.

pros: No platform fees on top of spreads.
Risk settings before the first trade.
cons: Registration details not stated up front.
The demo claim buried in the signup flow.
Performance examples without dates or proof.
Asset list that shifts between pages.
redFlags: Return claims without verification.
The fee that is not a fee: spreads embedded in every trade.
Restriction lists that name different countries.

faqs.a: The page promises payouts within a day, but the processing detail is thin. Confirm the exact timeline and any fees with support before funding anything.
9 crypto assets through broker partners, per the published pages. The list varies between sections, so check the dashboard after signup.

faqs.q: What happens after I sign up?
faqs.a: You confirm the account by email, fund US$300, set your risk preferences and choose automatic or manual mode. The demo account runs alongside while you learn.
Yes - the platform offers automatic and manual modes, so you can follow the signals or confirm each entry yourself.

faqs.q: How much support does it offer?
faqs.a: Unclear - around-the-clock coverage is claimed, while other sections quote different figures. Ask support to reconcile them before you fund anything.

bottomLine: As a product, Liquidity Gold offers the expected setup and nothing that breaks. The issues sit in the published claims, and the claims are avoidable if you trade the minimum.
We scored Liquidity Gold 4.6 out of 5. The deductions come from the disclosure gaps, not the mechanics. With the US$300 minimum and the demo as guardrails, the risk stays yours to control.
